}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "300100122" and "WR3000 REV1.1 sp2" are silkscreened on board top.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7981BA @1.3GHz (''Filogic 820'') :SoC: Dual-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Flash: 16MB (SPI NOR) [[XMC]] flash *Memory: 256MB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[MediaTek]] MT7981BA/MT7976CN :802.11abgn/ac/ax Dual Band (2.4/5GHz) :2×2 2.4GHz + 3×3 5GHz (2×2 + Zero-wait DFS) *Network: 4x 1GbE (WAN/LAN) ports *Power Source: 12V/1A via barrel
